chunks: And one of his sayings (peace be upon him) which he said when his companions were restless/discontented with him regarding the matter of Arbitration.

key_terms.اضْطَرَبَ: To be restless, unsettled, or discontented

ai.seo_question: What was the context of Imam Ali's statement regarding the companions' discontent with Arbitration?
ai.summary: This narration captures the critical moment during the Battle of Siffin when Imam Ali (AS) addressed the growing discontent of his troops regarding the acceptance of arbitration (Al-Hukm) with Mu'awiya. It reflects the internal political tension and the pragmatic necessity of preserving the Muslim community's unity amidst competing claims to legitimate authority. The event underscores the Shia perspective on leadership challenges and the balance between justice and political expediency.
